title: Italian Orange Pudding Toast
description: A sweet and tangy Italian-inspired breakfast dish featuring orange-infused pudding on toasted bread.
instructions: 1. Preheat a toaster or toaster oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. Toast the bread until lightly browned.
3. In a bowl, whisk together pudding and orange zest until well combined.
4. Spread the pudding mixture onto the toasted bread slices.
5. Slice the orange and arrange on top of the pudding.
